caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mechanical device composed primarily of brown wood with visible grain texture. The main structure is a long, horizontal wooden plank forming the base, supported at both ends by wide, splayed wooden legs with an angled shape. Near the center of the base, an upright rectangular wooden frame extends vertically, housing a cuboid section at the top with a vertically oriented, flat rectangular lever or paddle attached to one side. A separate, long, curved wooden handle projects outward from the left side, angled upward from the base, and connects through a smaller rectangular block to the central frame. The mechanical components are constructed from the same brown wood, and no metal fastenings are visible. The background is a plain, light tan color, and there are no other objects in the composition.
title: Butter Mold
